implementationAuthorization.instruction: Scope 01 security rework authorizes the existing shadow-only OMLX and Ollama paths plus scripts/brief-author.mjs only for an additive verifyAuthorRequestFingerprint(request) export that reuses the existing private canonicalizer and for its pre-dispatch use in invokeAuthor. Existing request builders, contracts, canonical projection, and emitted request/output bytes remain invariant. Every other exclusion entry, public artifact, and production scheduler path remains byte-identical. Bug packets must exist before implementation.

tests.description: Validate both shadow profiles, exact identities, the dynamic strict response schema, finite policy limits, safe-integer usage shapes, canonical request fingerprints, and static authority exclusions through pure production contracts.
tests.testTitle: Feature 030 shadow policy, dynamic strict response schema, transport-contract, authority, safe-integer receipt, canonical fingerprint, and every pure fail-loud boundary

tests.description: Run the production CLI against an ephemeral real HTTP server and prove missing, unknown, and incomplete profile selection refuses before any request.
tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-030-001 explicit profile resolves once or refuses before HTTP

tests.description: Prove canonical request verification and exact model discovery precede one bounded non-streaming completion whose dynamic strict schema fixes contractVersion and requestFingerprint and requires the exact three-key envelope: brief for tool-author v1/v2 or final for final-author v1, with an object value; require a stop finish reason, downstream strict validation, cancellation, safe-integer usage normalization, and no provider switch.
tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-030-002 exact model preflight precedes one bounded dynamic-schema completion

tests.description: As the final post-fix canary, call the actual explicitly configured OMLX endpoint with a canonically built and verified request, require exact model discovery, and validate the schema-fixed identity fields, exact three-key envelope, object content value, stop finish reason, downstream strict-validation result, and truthful safe-integer token states.
tests.testTitle: Regression E2E: SCN-030-002 OMLX returns the schema-fixed envelope, object payload, stop finish reason, and truthful usage state
tests.command: /usr/bin/env BRIEF_SHADOW_PROFILE=omlx-openai-compatible-qwen38 BRIEF_OMLX_BASE_URL="${BRIEF_OMLX_BASE_URL:?required for OMLX canary}" node --test --test-name-pattern "Regression E2E: SCN-030-002 OMLX" tests/*.local-canary.mjs

tests.description: As the final post-fix canary, call the actual explicitly configured Ollama endpoint with a canonically built and verified request, require exact model discovery, and validate the schema-fixed identity fields, exact three-key envelope, object content value, stop finish reason, downstream strict-validation result, and truthful safe-integer token states.
tests.testTitle: Regression E2E: SCN-030-002 Ollama returns the schema-fixed envelope, object payload, stop finish reason, and truthful usage state
tests.command: /usr/bin/env BRIEF_SHADOW_PROFILE=ollama-openai-compatible BRIEF_OLLAMA_BASE_URL="${BRIEF_OLLAMA_BASE_URL:?required for Ollama canary}" BRIEF_OLLAMA_MODEL="${BRIEF_OLLAMA_MODEL:?required for Ollama canary}" node --test --test-name-pattern "Regression E2E: SCN-030-002 Ollama" tests/*.local-canary.mjs

tests.description: Exercise model-list and chat bytes, deadlines, zero retries, and one in-flight completion at the exact cap and at cap plus one.
tests.testTitle: Stress: SCN-030-002 finite byte deadline retry and concurrency limits refuse at cap plus one

tests.description: Snapshot protected files, publication artifacts, scheduler status, Git state, stdout, and stderr around shadow invocation and reject publication flags and secret sentinels.
tests.testTitle: Regression: SCN-030-003 shadow invocation preserves authority and excludes secret sentinels

tests.description: Validate the current committed public payload with the unchanged authority and no shadow-output dependency.
tests.testTitle: Current committed public payload remains valid and does not consume shadow output

tests.description: Capture same-command RED and GREEN proof that each present token count is a non-negative safe integer, prompt plus completion cannot overflow, a present provider total is independently safe, and missing or null values remain unmeasured without a synthesized zero or total.
tests.testTitle: Security regression: SCN-030-002 unsafe token counts and overflow refuse before normalized usage
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern "Security regression: SCN-030-002 unsafe token counts and overflow refuse before normalized usage" tests/brief-openai-compatible-adapter.functional.mjs

tests.description: Capture same-command RED and GREEN proof that retaining a request digest while mutating each canonical field refuses in invokeAuthor, the route runtime, and the OpenAI-compatible adapter before callback, child spawn, route dispatch, model preflight, or HTTP work.
tests.testTitle: Security regression: SCN-030-003 retained request fingerprint mutation refuses before process transport or HTTP dispatch
tests.command: node --test --test-name-pattern "Security regression: SCN-030-003 retained request fingerprint mutation refuses before process transport or HTTP dispatch" tests/brief-openai-compatible-adapter.functional.mjs
